Proprietors as listed in the directories added by Common Ground (machine-assisted).

body.p: Otago Hotel was located on Pelham Street.

The directories list the proprietors as Ellen Hogan (1875 and 1876), George Daly (1877), J. H. Brenan (1878), Jer. Collins (1879) and Miss Rosa McManus (1880). Machine-assisted first draft by Common Ground, from the directory records.
